rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something intended mainly to add visual appeal.

example.english: This lamp is quite decorative, but it does not give much light.
example.traditional: 呢盞燈好有裝飾性，但照明唔夠。
example.jyutping: nei1 zaan2 dang1 hou2 jau5 zong1 sik1 sing3 daan6 ziu3 ming4 m4 gau3

rows.note: Use this when stressing that the item is ornamental only and has no practical function.

example.english: Those two columns by the entrance are purely decorative and have no practical use.
example.traditional: 門口嗰兩根柱係純裝飾，完全冇實際用途。
example.jyutping: mun4 hau2 go2 loeng5 gan1 cyu5 hai6 seon4 zong1 sik1 jyun4 cyun4 mou5 sat6 zai3 jung6 tou4
